title: Moon Dust Smells Like Gunpowder and Wore Through Astronaut Boots

scenes.text: Astronauts said moon dust smells like spent gunpowder.
Apollo 17's Gene Cernan said it was like someone had just fired a carbine.
It looks like soft grey snow, but nothing on the Moon ever wore its edges down.
It wore through three layers of Kevlar like material on one astronaut's boot.
Harrison Schmitt sneezed and itched for about two hours. He called it lunar dust hay fever.
It's closer to ground up glass than snow.

description:
Apollo astronauts said moon dust smelled like spent gunpowder, and Gene Cernan compared it to a freshly fired carbine.
The dust is sharp and abrasive, and it wore through three layers of Kevlar-like material on one boot.
